name: All 9 Lives
storyline:
You were born with 9 lives, but during battle you have the ability to trade each life for a unique power. The more powers you have, the less lives you get.

Guns deal a LOT of damage... but trading a life for a bulletproof vest will help. A vest may help, but your opponent might choose faster reloads for when your protection is gone. What will you do next?

The loser gets to edit their loadout after each round. To win you must think carefully and adapt to any situation.
summary:
Trade your lives for POWER. Fight against your friends with endless character customization possibilities and rollback netcode.

All 9 Lives is a small indie fighting game, playable on web browsers for free. The Steam version has a few exclusive benefits:
- Faster load times
- Playable without an internet connection
- Bonus stages
- Arcade mode with unique character endings
- Practice mode with advanced features
- Exclusive "Steam Supporter" tag for to use online
- Development support for additional features and content.
